Sec. 514.220, RSMo 1959, V.A.M.S., is the same as Civil Rule 77.21, V.A.M.R., and, in that part pertinent to the issue here presented, provides: “In all cases founded on the statutes concerning the partition of lands, the costs shall be paid by the parties plaintiff and defendant, according to their respective interests in the lands which may be the subject of the proceedings; * * This language is clear and unequivocal.
